name: block-suppression
note: css-display-3 §2: the display:contents element generates no box — its margin/padding/border/background paint nothing (a stray paint shows on the screenshot layer), its rect is the all-zero total-map entry, and its children lay out directly in the grandparent's block formatting context. A nested contents chain (outer > nested > deep) splices recursively, and an inline contents element inside a mixed run contributes its text to the parent's anonymous inline box. Pseudo-element boxes of a contents element (rendered by Chrome) are not produced by this engine — documented divergence, not exercised here.
